name: Conventions screen offers a scan and lives under Skills Lab
description: Loads /repos/:repoId/conventions on a freshly-seeded DB, where no scan has ever run. Confirms the empty state, the single Run scan button (no Re-scan before a first scan), and that Conventions and Agents both sit in the SKILLS LAB section of the sidebar. Deliberately does NOT press Run scan: that calls a model, and these flows are deterministic and key-free.
